description: Send documents for e-signature with Documenso, the open-source signing app: from a template or a PDF, then follow each signer, remind them and save the signed PDF. Start a workflow when a document is completed, signed or rejected.

documenso_document_completed_trigger.description: Runs when everyone has signed a Documenso document, so the signed PDF is ready to download.

parameters.description: Only documents made from this template. Leave blank for every document.
parameters.name: template

documenso_document_rejected_trigger.description: Runs when a recipient rejects a Documenso document instead of signing it, with the reason they gave.

parameters.description: Only documents made from this template. Leave blank for every document.
parameters.name: template

documenso_recipient_signed_trigger.description: Runs each time one person signs or approves a Documenso document, the last of them included.

parameters.description: Only documents made from this template. Leave blank for every document.
parameters.name: template
